description: Streams, saves and growth per track, which stores and playlists the listening comes from, TikTok use, the audience's age and gender, how the artist's promotion posts performed, and their followers. For the whole catalog, when the artist has connected their own Songstats account, it also gives their numbers across the web (listeners, followers, playlist reach, socials, Shazam, charts), the cities they are listened to in now, the playlists carrying them and dated events. The same numbers the artist sees in Audora. Use it to answer "how is my release doing", to write a pitch or bio from real numbers, or to suggest where to focus next. When a figure is missing, say "not reported yet", never zero.

album_id.description: Every track on one album or EP.

artist.description: Only when you are connected as a label: the roster artist this call is for — their artist_user_id from list_roster, or their exact artist name. Required for every artist tool on a label connection. Leave it out on an artist's own connection.

track_id.description: One track. Leave out both ids for the whole catalog, which also includes posts, followers and audience.
